hero.slide1.title: Committed to Excellence and Quality Services
hero.slide1.desc: Africa Insurance Company (AIC) S.C. combines three decades of financial solvency, over ETB 603 million in paid-up capital, and authoritative protection for Ethiopian families and national enterprises.
hero.slide2.title: Comprehensive Motor & Fleet Risk Protection for Ethiopian Roads
hero.slide2.desc: End-to-end risk underwriting for private vehicles, commercial trucks, passenger transport, and national freight fleets along the Djibouti corridor with 24/7 emergency claims assistance.
hero.slide3.title: Safeguarding Manufacturing Plants, Warehouses & Real Estate
hero.slide3.desc: Comprehensive fire, lightning, earthquake, explosion, and business interruption policies protecting industrial complexes, agro-processing facilities, and commercial buildings across all regions.
hero.slide4.title: Marine Cargo & Hull Insurance for National Import & Export
hero.slide4.desc: Robust transit coverage safeguarding sea freight, air shipments, and container transit from international dispatch to Modjo Dry Port and customs clearing terminals across Ethiopia.
hero.slide5.title: Institutional Life, Medical & Workmen’s Compensation
hero.slide5.desc: Customized employee healthcare plans, group personal accident indemnities, and statutory employer liability schemes securing enterprise workforce well-being and family financial security.
